description:
With the Friends Reunion out now and Serendipity releasing some VERY specific linked ice creams, it made sense to recreate their new flavour "Central Perk Coffee Almond Fudge"...damn what a long name!

I love Coffee ice cream and although the reviews for this online are "sketchy", the combo of flavours is actually pretty EPIC. So why not grab the ingredients needed and make this yourself. 

The description on their website is the most basic i've ever seen so made my version from scratch. 

The Coffee Ice Cream Ingredients:
300 ml Whole milk
150 g Granulated sugar
1/4 Teaspoon salt
3-4 Tsp of Instant coffee
3 Egg yolks
300 ml Double (Heavy) cream
1 Tsp Vanilla extract

The Dairymilk Fudge Ingredients:
110g Dairymilk Chocolate
110g Butter
1 Egg
25g Sugar

Plus Dark Chocolate Covered Almonds. I used 50-75g. 

This scoops really well once frozen, is really creamy with a real PUNCH of caffeine. You can sub the coffee for decaf if you want. This fudge doesn't work with every chocolate so if you use a different brand, you might need to adjust the recipe slightly.
